chat.insicura.cosa_fare: Open ESTIA from an address starting with «https://», or from «localhost» on the machine running the instance. The other parts of ESTIA work anyway: only private messages stop here.
chat.insicura.segnaposto: Private messages can't be written here
chat.insicura.testo: The browser keeps encryption off when the address is not protected, and ESTIA does not send private messages without encryption. From this connection you can neither read nor write — and while you come in from here, nobody can write to you.
chat.insicura.titolo: Private messages don't work on this connection
chat.senza_dispositivo.cosa_fare: Let them know some other way: they only need to sign in to ESTIA once from an «https://» address or from «localhost». From then on you can write to them, and they won't have to do it again.
chat.senza_dispositivo.testo: A private message is locked with a key that is made on the device of whoever reads it, and {nome} doesn't have one yet. There is nothing to encrypt to, and ESTIA does not send messages in the clear — not even once.

registro.vuoto.testo: This is where decisions end up: who joins, and which invitations are born and die.
informazioni.estia.testo: A social network whose content physically lives on a machine that is yours, or your community's. There is no algorithm deciding the order, there are no ads, and there is no company in the middle that has to be taken at its word.
informazioni.estia.copie: What you write here is not copied elsewhere. When you delete a post it is really deleted, because no copy of it exists anywhere else.
informazioni.licenza.testo: ESTIA is free software under {licenza}. Anyone can read its code, change it and host a copy; whoever offers it to others as a service must make their changes available. It is the licence that makes it hard to turn ESTIA into the thing it wants to protect you from.
chiavi.assenti.cosa_fare: Open ESTIA from an address that starts with «https://», or from «localhost» on the machine where the instance runs: the keys are created by themselves, once, and you will not have to do it again.
chiavi.assenti.testo: Without them you cannot read or write private messages, and — this is the part you do not see — nobody can write to you: whoever tries gets a refusal. It happens when you come in from an address the browser does not consider protected, because there cryptography is switched off.
chiavi.assenti.titolo: This browser does not have the keys for private messages
chiavi.in_attesa.cosa_fare: Open ESTIA on a device where you are already signed in, go to Settings → Chat, and compare the code you see there with the one below. If they match, say yes.
chiavi.in_attesa.testo: The keys are here, but nobody has said yet that this device is you. While it waits it does not join your conversations, and nothing changes on the device you already had — nothing is lost.
chiavi.in_attesa.titolo: This device is waiting for your yes
chiavi.senza_copia.cosa_fare: Choose a secret phrase below and create the copy. It takes ten seconds and you do it only once.
chiavi.senza_copia.testo: No copy of them exists. If you sign out here, or if this browser is cleared, you will come back with a new key: the conversations come back, but this browser stays in them as one more device of yours, and the history reopens only when the other people reopen each conversation.
chiavi.senza_copia.titolo: The keys are here, but they live only in this browser
chiavi.con_copia.testo: A copy exists on the instance, updated on {data}. Signing in from a new browser you will be able to put this same key back with your secret phrase, and rejoin the conversations in place of the previous browser.
chiavi.con_copia.titolo: The keys are here, and you have a copy
chiavi.come_funzionano: The keys of private messages are born in this browser and stay here: the instance does not have them, whoever writes to you does not have them, nobody has them. That is what makes your messages unreadable even to whoever hosts ESTIA — and it is also why a new browser does not open old messages by itself: another person in the conversation reopens them for it, the first time they reopen it.
chiavi.piu_dispositivi: You can use ESTIA from several devices at once: each one, once authorised, joins each conversation by itself the first time you open it, and the others stay on. On a device that has just come in, the history of a conversation opens when another person in that conversation reopens it.
chiavi.avviso_uscita: Signing out, the key disappears from this browser, and no copy of it exists. Signing back in, a new one will be created: you will find the conversations again, but the history will reopen only when the other people reopen them, and this browser will stay in them as one more device of yours.

dispositivi.disconnettere: Disconnecting a device throws it out at once, wherever it is: no waiting, and no expiry to wait for.
dispositivi.uscire.con_copia: Signing out, the chat keys disappear from this browser. A copy of them exists, so you will be able to put them back by signing in with your secret phrase.

dispositivi.senza_copia.esci: Sign out anyway, and lose the messages

chat_chiavi.le_chiavi: The keys of your private messages
chat_chiavi.copia.testo: A secret phrase you choose locks your keys in a copy that the instance keeps {senza_aprire}. It serves one purpose only: putting the same keys on a new browser, so you find your earlier messages again. {non_conversazioni} — those are already on the instance and stay there.
chat_chiavi.copia.senza_aprire: without being able to open it
chat_chiavi.copia.non_conversazioni: It is not a copy of the conversations
chat_chiavi.frase.aiuto: If you forget it, it cannot be recovered, and the copy becomes useless. The instance never knows it.

presenza.istanza.intro: On this instance anyone can find you in search. Here you decide what someone who opens your profile sees: your posts, or only the chance to ask to follow you.
presenza.privato.nota: Whoever opens your profile can ask to follow you. They see your posts only after you have accepted.
presenza.istanza.pubblico.nota: Whoever opens your profile sees your posts. They can follow you without waiting for a yes.
presenza.rete.intro: On the network between instances, if you are in EstiaNet, anyone can find you in the search of the linked instances. Here you decide what someone who opens your profile sees: your posts, or only the chance to ask to follow you.
presenza.rete.solo_preferenza: It applies when you join EstiaNet: while you are outside, it stays only a preference.
presenza.rete.pubblico.nota: Whoever opens your profile sees your network posts.
presenza.estianet.dentro: Linked instances can find you and open your profile, within the private or public limits chosen above.
presenza.estianet.fuori: You are only on this instance. No other instance knows you are here, and you do not appear in their searches.

inviti.entrato: {nome} is now part of this instance.
inviti.rifiutata: Request declined: the person does not come in, and the invitation stays as it was.
inviti.nessuno_aspetta: Nobody is waiting right now. Whoever opens an invitation chooses a name and asks to come in: the request appears here, because an invitation lets nobody in by itself — you open the door.
inviti.decidi_qui: An invitation lets nobody in by itself: you decide here who comes in.
inviti.nuovo.testo: The link is valid until it expires or is used up, and you can withdraw it whenever you want. Whoever receives it does not come in: they ask to come in, and the request comes back up here.
inviti.etichetta.aiuto: To remember who you gave it to. Only you see it.
inviti.riutilizzabile.nota: A single-use invitation is safer: if it passes from hand to hand, a new one is needed each time.
inviti.ritirato: Invitation withdrawn: from now on that link no longer lets anyone ask to come in.

backup.coppia_generata: Pair generated. Keep the private key outside this NAS, then press Save.
backup.salvato: Saved. Automatic backups use these settings.
backup.scritto: Backup written. You will find it in the list below.
backup.non_funzionano: Backups are set up but {forte}. Until it is fixed, this instance has nowhere to go back to.
backup.serve_coppia: A key pair is needed: the instance keeps only the public one and writes archives it cannot read back. You see the private one only once — put it outside this NAS.
backup.da_ambiente: These settings come from the container's environment variables: here you can see them, not change them.
backup.riassunto: Every {ore} hours · keeps the last {archivi} archives.
backup.ore_etichetta: Hours between one backup and the next
backup.chiave_privata: This is the {privata}. It appears only once: without it nobody can reopen your backups. Put it in a password manager, or print it — {fuori}. Then press Save.
backup.chiave_impostata: Set. You only need it if you want to change it — a new key does not open the old archives.
backup.chiave_nuova: A new key does not open the archives already written. Generate one only if you have lost the private one, or if you want to start from scratch.
backup.pubblica.aiuto: Only this half lives on the instance. It starts with age1…
backup.stesso_disco: The archives are {disco}: they protect against a mistake and a failed update, not against the disk breaking or the NAS being stolen. Download one now and then from the list below and keep it elsewhere.
backup.stesso_disco.disco: on the same disk as the data
backup.scaricane: Download one now and then and keep it outside the NAS. They are encrypted: you can put them anywhere.
backup.nessuno: No archive yet. If you have just turned on backups, the first one arrives within a minute.
backup.ripristino: {forte}, on purpose: it is needed exactly when this page no longer opens. It is done from a terminal, with an archive and the private key — it is in the installation guide.
backup.ripristino.forte: Restoring is not done from here
stato.origine.overlay: from outside, through the private network
stato.senza_backup_ora_si: This update was applied without a backup first. Migrations only go forward: it has no way back, and cannot get one later. Backups are now configured — the next update will have one.
stato.anonimo: {titolo} They are on a volume Docker created by itself, without anyone asking: it carries it along only when {compose} recreates the container. The NAS's «update» button, Portainer and Watchtower attach a new, empty one instead, and the instance starts again from zero — accounts, content, photos and the private key, which {insostituibile}. The old data is not deleted: it stays in an orphan volume, and can be recovered.
stato.anonimo.titolo: This data is lost if you update from the panel.
stato.effimero: {titolo} They are not on a volume: they are inside the container, which is thrown away and rebuilt every time you update the image. Accounts, content, photos and the instance's private key go with it, and the key {insostituibile}.
stato.effimero.titolo: Your data will disappear at the next update.
stato.pubblico: {titolo} and outside the private network. There are two explanations: either a port towards the NAS is open on the router — and then the instance is on the Internet, which it should not be — or between you and it there is a proxy hiding the caller's address. It is worth establishing which of the two.
stato.pubblico.titolo: Someone arrived from an address outside the home network
stato.incoerente: The configuration declares an encryption the instance does not detect. Until it is cleared up, consider the data {non_protetti} against the NAS being stolen.
stato.conta_tipi: The instance counts kinds of network, not addresses: whether from outside or inside is the administrator's business, from which address is nobody's.
stato.permessi.testo: The filesystem refused to tighten it to 0700: other users of this machine can list its contents. It happens on network shares and on some bind mounts.
stato.versione: Version {da} → {a}, on {quando}. It concerns only that update, not the state of today's backups.
stato.aggiornamenti.intro: Check whether a newer version of ESTIA is available. To update the instance, just run the command {comando} in the terminal of the machine or the NAS. Before updating, make sure backups are on.
stato.comando.nota: Copy and run this command in the terminal of the NAS or server: it downloads the new image, recognises the configuration and restarts the instance keeping your data.
stato.passi_manuali: Don't have the «estia» command? Show the manual Docker steps

estianet.modi.spiegazione: «Home network» touches no third-party infrastructure and is useful if the two homes are under the same Wi-Fi router. «From outside too» uses iroh's discovery servers and relays to find each other across different homes.
estianet.da_ambiente: Set by {variabile} in the configuration file: you can see it here but not change it, because a restart would undo the change.
estianet.chiave.testo: It is the only thing to give to whoever wants to link with this home. {mai}: it is derived from the instance's permanent identity and survives restarts, updates and restores from backup.
estianet.qr.nota: Point the camera at this code to take the key at once.
estianet.ticket.testo: In {modo} mode (home network) there is no global discovery: share this code instead, which includes the machine's current IP addresses.
estianet.collega.testo_chiave: Paste the other home's public key here. The link becomes active when someone {anche} says yes: it is a decision for two, and it cannot be made from one side alone.
estianet.collega.testo_codice: Paste the other home's code here. The link becomes active when someone {anche} says yes: it is a decision for two, and it cannot be made from one side alone.
estianet.collega.locale: On «home network» there is no discovery: here you paste the other home's long code, not just the key.
estianet.case.testo: This home asks the linked homes by itself whether they are there, {ogni}, even while nobody is looking at this page. The outcome is below. A home that does not answer needs nothing by hand: it is tried again by itself, with the attempts spaced further apart.
estianet.case.nessuna: No linked home for now. When there is one, the members of the two homes will find each other in search and will be able to follow each other.
estianet.spegni.testo: This home stops letting itself be found and looking for the others. The links are not lost — they stay in the list and come back when you turn it on again — but while it is off no content crosses and no message leaves for another home.
